bṯꜣ: bṯꜣ — to do wrong, sin, rebel (verb); wrong, wrongdoing (noun; bṯꜣ·f 'his wrong')
imy-wt: imy-wt — 'He who is in the place of embalming', a title of Anubis (noun m.; nisba imy 'who is in' + wt 'embalming place, wrappings'; Budge: àm ut)
ini: ini — to bring, fetch (verb 3ae-inf.; sḏm·n·f in·n·i 'I have brought')
nkꜣw: nkꜣw — evil things, harm (?) (noun, plural; rare word, sense uncertain)
ntk: ntk — you, thou (independent pronoun, 2nd person masc. sing.; ntk N 'you are N', a sentence without a verb)
nṯrt: nṯrt — goddess (noun f.; feminine of nṯr 'god')
pꜣwt: pꜣwt — company, cycle (of gods) (noun f.; pꜣwt nṯrw 'the company of gods')
r-pr: r-pr — temple, chapel, sanctuary (noun m.; lit. 'mouth of the house'; plural r-prw)
rq: rq — hostility, opposition (noun; from the verb rq 'turn aside, oppose'; rq·k 'your hostility') (?)
snnw: snnw — second (ordinal numeral; from sn 'two'); sp snnw 'a second time'
snw: snw — offering loaves, bread offerings (noun m., plural)
swḏꜣ: swḏꜣ — to make sound, keep whole, preserve (verb; causative of wḏꜣ 'be sound, whole')
sḫr: sḫr — make foul, do harm (?) (verb; sense uncertain, perhaps 'make stink', cf. sḫr 'plan, manner' (noun m.))
sḫt-ḥtpw: sḫt-ḥtpw — the Field of Offerings, the land of plenty of the blessed dead (place name; Budge: Sekhet-hetepu)
wpi: wpi — to open, part, separate (verb 3ae-inf.); wp-mꜣꜥt 'one who judges what is right' (participle + object)
šnyt: šnyt — the entourage, court, those who stand around a god (collective noun f.; from šni 'surround'; Budge: Shenit)
ḥn: ḥn — to hasten (?) (verb; Budge's guess for a doubtful sign)
ḥsi: ḥsi — to praise, favour (verb 3ae-inf.); ḥsy 'favoured one' (passive participle used as a noun; plural ḥsyw)
ḫnmw: ḫnmw — Khnum, the ram-headed god who shapes bodies on his potter's wheel (god's name; related to ḫnm 'join, fashion'; Budge reads the word as the verb χnem 'formeth')
ḫprw: ḫprw — forms, manifestations, ways of coming into being (noun m., plural; from ḫpr 'become')
ꜣst: ꜣst — Isis, wife of Osiris and mother of Horus (goddess's name; 'seat, throne'; Budge: Àuset)
ꜥm-mwt: ꜥm-mwt — Ammit, 'Swallower of the dead', the beast that devours the condemned heart (demon's name; from ꜥm 'swallow' + mwt 'the dead'; Budge: Āmemet)

__broaden__.m: m — in, from (preposition) · also "with" (instrument), "as" (m bnw "as the Bennu"), "on" (living on), "by"; im before a suffix (im·i, im·f, im·tn) · a second word of the same spelling: what? (interrogative pronoun; r m 'for what? why?') · also 'among' (with a group of people) · also the negative imperative 'do not!' (before a verb form: m irt 'do not make'; from the verb imi)
__broaden__.ḏr: ḏr — limit, border, end (noun) · also 'since, when' (conjunction before a verb form: ḏr wnn·f 'since he was')
__broaden__.sḫm: sḫm — power, might; sacred image, cult statue (noun) · also the verb 'prevail, have power (over: m)' (sḫm m 'have power over')
__broaden__.sš: sš — scribe (noun; the palette-and-pen sign) · a second word of the same spelling: to pass, go through (verb; doubtful here) · also to write, draw, paint (verb; written with the scribe's palette) · also the noun 'writing, document, record' (noun m.)
__broaden__.wḏꜥ: wḏꜥ — to judge, separate (verb); wḏꜥ(w)t 'judgement, decision' (noun) · also to judge a person or heart (set on the balance), pass judgement on (wḏꜥ·n 'has judged'; participle 'one who judges')
